title: Fylgja bundle 1 manifest
description: The manifest of a runtime-neutral bundle: what the compiler made of one blueprint and the loaded packages. A driver's plan binds it to a twin and a runtime; nothing in it belongs to one twin, so one bundle can back many twins on any driver.
$comment: LAYOUT. A bundle is a set of regular files in the state store, addressed by its id: manifest.json, this document as RFC 8785 (JCS) bytes with no trailing newline; configs/<node>.cfg, the blueprint device's config verbatim. Nothing else: the topology, the lab name, the images and the fidelity are a driver plan's output, not the bundle's. There is no bootstrap file (D-015): each kind's baseline holds the hostname, linked ports enabled, LLDP and gNMI. Node names become file names, so the compiler rejects a device name holding '/', NUL or beginning with '.' (rule device.name.unsafe). ID. The bundle id is the lowercase-hex SHA-256 of a listing of every file: one line '<sha256 of the file's bytes, lowercase hex>  <path relative to the bundle root>\n' (two spaces, as sha256sum writes) per file, in byte-wise path order. By hand: ( cd <bundle> && find . -type f | sed 's|^\./||' | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1 ). The id is never written into the bundle. Since the manifest is JCS bytes, the same blueprint and packages give the same id on every machine; since fidelity and package wording are not in it, rewording a package moves no bundle id. On clabernetes the configs reach the nodes as ConfigMaps; locally they are files beside the rendered topology. ORDER. Every list is sorted as the blueprint's are; mapping by (device, interface).

bundle_version.description: The format's version; every driver's plan refuses any other (rule bundle.version.unsupported).

blueprint_id.description: The blueprint compiled; the twin record, show and the orchestrator's reports reach the source envelope through it.

nodes.description: One per blueprint device, sorted by name; the plan renders each as a runtime node, the push sends its files, bundle diff compares them.

mapping.description: One row per blueprint interface, sorted by (device, interface); the plan renders endpoint names from it, verify reads node names from it, fidelity counts its omissions.

links.description: The cabled links between devices, in production names, sorted; the plan wires them, verify checks each far end, bundle diff compares them.

probes.description: The probes as placed (every endpoint checked against the mapping), sorted by name; the plan renders each probe's hosts <name>-a and <name>-b and their links, flows and verify's burst run them.

file.description: The file's path in the bundle; the plan places it beside the topology or in a ConfigMap, the push reads it.

sha256.description: The file's SHA-256; bundle diff and the push compare it with what a node holds without reading the file.

name.description: The device's name; the plan names the runtime node by it, and the twin record's nodes key on it.

platform.description: The platform package's id; the plan reads its runtime section, the push, readiness and verify their platform-level sections.

config.description: The source-rendered configuration; the push sends it inside the replace, onto the kind's baseline.

device.description: The device, by name; part of the row's key.

interface.description: The production interface name; part of the row's key, and the endpoint name the plan emits where the kind has aliases.

rule.description: The package rule that matched; the plan finds a rename by it, fidelity names it. Absent when no rule matched.

enabled.description: The blueprint's intended admin state; verify skips a disabled port. The kind enables every linked port by default (verified on containerlab 0.79 and clabernetes 0.10.1, 2026-10-30); disabling one is the source-rendered config's to do.

disposition.description: What the twin makes of the interface: a wired port, a port with no link, the management port, or nothing; the plan, verify and fidelity branch on it.

node_name.description: What the node's OS calls the port; verify renders {node_name} with it. Absent on an omitted row.

omission.description: Why the interface is not represented; fidelity reports it. Present only on an omitted row.
